versions.changelog:
Content Repurposer skill v1.0.0

- Initial release enabling conversion of long-form content into platform-optimized social posts, summaries, and newsletter snippets.
- Supports multiple input types: URLs, YouTube transcripts, pasted text, and files (.md, .txt, .html, .pdf).
- Analyzes source content for core message, key points, quotable lines, audience, and type.
- Generates ready-to-post content for Twitter/X (threads and single posts), LinkedIn, Instagram, Reddit, Hacker News, newsletters, and summaries.
- Customization options for tone, platform selection, audience, content length, CTA, hashtags, emoji, and language.
- Adheres to platform-specific formatting and best practices via referenced guides.
